title: Write unit tests for merge_intervals
description: `src/intervals.py` contains a correct `merge_intervals`. Create `tests/test_intervals.py` (standard `unittest`, runnable with `python -m unittest discover -s tests` from the workspace root) that checks its documented behaviour thoroughly enough to catch plausible implementation mistakes. Do not modify `src/intervals.py`.
success_criteria: The tests pass against the reference implementation and fail against each of three hidden faulty variants.
